summary: 38-year-old solo hiker fell in the Diamond Lake area west of Nederland, sustaining multiple injuries including suspected lower-extremity fractures; Boulder County Sheriff's Office report about 4:18 p.m. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Nederland Fire Protection District responded; a Colorado Army National Guard UH-60L Black Hawk suffered a blade strike about 10:15 p.m. during a hoist attempt and made a precautionary landing near the Fourth of July Trailhead at Buckingham Park with no injuries aboard; a UH-72B Lakota hoisted the hiker about 12:21 a.m. Nov 1 to Nederland High School, then by ambulance to a Boulder hospital.
location: Diamond Lake area, west of Nederland
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-03: Unofficial Networks report citing the Boulder County Sheriff's Office and Colorado National Guard; rescue completed early Nov 1.
